source.note: Batch 31 Memory P1 official public main build (commit 3825662d16e04f8f1163bb840f2ce1eefc3d6d43, PR #123 and PR #122 188d9f6ce33b26905494fc57508d10b8015af857 on top of public main 4493a5eb418af29a253d38499682dc2be99697b1, PR #121 018947ae, PR #120 7e2de40b, PR #119 c764d970, PR #117 14e13911, and PR #115 5cbf2601); adds bounded revision history and restore (MEM-10, MEM-19), export v2 with hardened state/meta reconciliation and bounded batch import (MEM-11), and generic object applicability (appliesWhen.objects), with no vendor patch and no dirty files.
